notes.title: Trapper's Delight 1.0 Available Now!
notes.content:
Trapper's Delight is now officially out of early access with an official 1.0 release. 

Since going into Early Access almost 2(!!!) years ago the game has received a lot of major updates. These include:

 Addition of level editor and Steam Workshop support 
 Singleplayer Challenge Mode including 48 new levels 
 Complete UI overhauls of in-game interface and menus 
 Major networking improvements/rewrites 
 New trap types added 
 Gameplay balance changes 
 Localisation support including 5 additional languages 
 And so very many bug fixes! 


Now that the game has received all of these updates and improvements I now feel like the game can be considered a complete package. So with that in mind, it makes sense that the game is now be marked as 1.0 and move the game out of early access.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/0901f6e1d08b1b0ebb1b20b5953f3641a51bb3db.png

New Launch Trailer

To mark this momentous occasion, there is a new launch trailer for Trapper's Delight, which you can watch here on youtube.

Special Thanks 

I would also like to give special thanks to everyone in the Trapper's Delight community and your continued support through early access. Your suggestions and feedback have really helped get the game to the state it is in today, so thank you so very much!

notes.title: Update 0.9.9.7 (1.0 Release Candidate)
notes.content:
The march towards a stable 1.0 release continues! This patch contains a lot of major fixes including some big networking improvements that should fix a lot of disconnection issues.

The fixes list is steadily shrinking so a full release is coming soon!

Patch notes below:

Bug Fixes


Lots of network efficiency improvements. Various traps now use a much more consistent method to synchronize over the network which should vastly improve network performance
Visual fixes on Timed Pit traps which was causing some nasty z-fighting when traps were placed next to each other
Fixed stencil buffer error which was causing the engine to produce lots of useless error messages in the log file.
Fixed camera positioning when two players die simultaneously in local multiplayer
Fixed the screen being revealed when quitting a game during a state transition
Fixed characters skin colour not being synced correctly over the network
Fixed bug where the character portraits at the bottom of the screen would sometimes show the wrong player
Various fixes for errors that could occur when during a game during a scene transition
Fixed an error that could occur which would cause a pop-up window to get stuck on the screen
Fixed an error where the trap placing UI would look incorrect briefly after placing a trap
Fixed a bug that would cause a tile to be “locked” in local multiplayer, preventing more traps being placed on that tile
Fixed round counting in the game being inconsistent
Fixed local multiplayer profile/character customise menus getting out of sync when players joined in a specific order in local multiplayer


General
Updated app icon
Local multiplayer UI minor tweaks
Improved loading of level metadata which should fix the issue where pressing “Create Game” in the main menu would cause the menu to freeze for a second or two
Tidied up trap/reset projectile logic between game states
Tweaked Hammer traps player interactions
Improved the UI for the score screen overlay, the buttons now appear correctly when they are interactive
Updated the mid-game join overlay which appears when during a game in progress
Removed the “Display” option as it no longer works in the version of the Unity engine being used. It is still possible to change the display by switching to window mode, and moving the game to the other display and full-screening the game.
The UI for controller remapping in local multiplayer now correctly shows both Playstation and Xbox prompts when appropriate
Trap placement in local multiplayer should now never get into a state where no trap is selected in some rare cases
Improved how flipper and jump traps animate when triggered multiple times in quick succession
Improved text entry for new player name when creating a new local multiplayer profile
The “Find players on discord” button is now selectable on the menu with a controller

notes.title: Update 0.99.6 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Another patch out today, as we march towards a 1.0 release!
Update 0.99.6 comes with quite a few improvements all over the game. Here are the full patch notes:

Features

 Added a new lobby scene
 Updated the visuals on the main menu, now features traps
 Added a visual trail to projectiles
 Added 8 new challenge levels, bringing the total up to 48
 Tweaked challenge game mode flow so that it is faster to restart after dying
 Updated some old help images
 Balance changes for how often clear traps appear, including Clear Floor, Bombs and Mines. They will now appear less often during gameplay, as previously they were being given too players too much.
 Safe zones generated by Clear Space now last only one round instead of the previous three


Bug Fixes

 Fixed not being able to place traps behind some UI elements, such as the + Trap Name overlay
 Added some changes which should hopefully help with the issue where you might be randomly removed from an online game for no discernable reason
 Fixed traps and powerups such as Speed not triggering if you ran over them as soon as the game started
 Fixed some traps not correctly resetting between rounds, specifically lava pit traps sometimes being stuck in a weird state
 Fixed traps not animating in when starting a new level in Challenge mode
 Some visual fixes on grabber/puncher traps
 General networking improvements
 Fixed a bug where the challenge level selector would not open correctly when opened a second time
 Spear Guards in challenge mode will now correctly charge multiple times if possible.

notes.title: Trapper's Delight Goes Multilingual!
notes.content:
In exciting news, Trapper's Delight has now been localized into 5 new languages!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/ada3e1885a8512b787f8d20c7b547d55bdc38067.png

As of today, players all around the world can enjoy Trapper's Delight with the addition of the following languages:

 Brazilian Portuguese
 French
 German
 Simplified Chinese
 Russian 
If you are a native speaker of any of these languages and find any issues with the localization, please let me know! Come find me on the Trapper's Delight discord or post on the Steam forums with your comments.

With this addition, the game is bumped up to version 0.9.9.1, which includes a few new changes.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/20482963dcbdc63cbde51fd47e21763495f24cad.png

Change List

 Added localization support for 5 new languages, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Simplified Chinese and Russian.
 Added Language selection in the Options menu under "System"
 Many minor UI improvements and tweaks to provide a consistent experience between languages
 Added Discord Rich Presence support. While playing Trapper's Delight, game information is now displayed on Discord and it is also possible to invite players to your game through Discord. (Note: This is not currently on supported Mac OSX)


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/d743c4d5796e181f2bb5caa7252b89911756b77f.png

notes.title: Trapper's Delight 0.99 Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's new update day! This patch brings with it a whole load of new traps and tricks to play around with, so check it out. Update notes below...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/d75b854e0ff3855c8043028468d15517216b7f7c.gif

New Traps

Puncher Trap
This trap shoots out a giant novelty-sized boxing glove which punches players away. The counterpart for the grabber trap.

Mine
A hidden explosive trap, this explodes just like the bomb trap when stepped on after a short delay. If you are quick to react it is possible to get out of the way, but as a hidden trap which explodes nearby traps this opens up some new possibilities.

Slow
A hidden trap which works similarly to the freeze trap. When revealed it slows any player that steps on it for a few seconds, making any upcoming obstacles harder to get past.

Speed
A visible floor tile which is the counterpart of the slow trap. Can be placed as an incentive to be the first to reach, as only one player can activate the speed powerup contained within. The first player to step on the tile will receive a temporary speed boost, potentially allowing them to get past obstacles (or just take themselves out faster!)

Projectile Shield
Similar to the speed trap, this is a floor tile which grants a boon to the first player that steps over it. This player will be given a shield which will let them survive a projectile hit and will then fade away.

Clear Floor
This can be used to will remove any trap from a floor tile and replace it with a safe zone. This safe zone cannot be built on but it will gradually fade back into a normal floor tile after a few turns. This tile will only be awarded when players are failing to beat a level.

Visible Flipper
This is a minor rework with how flippers work. There is now a new variant which is a visible flipper variant which will appear alongside the hidden flipper trap. The flipper trap is renamed to “Hidden Flipper” and this new trap is just called “Flipper” trap.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/5891951c7abdc3b255e7defd421c1653c639a5ff.gif

Other Changes

 Improved visuals for player elimination, players can now explode in a comical fashion depending on how they are eliminated
 Improved visuals for the existing projectile traps
 Improved UI for trap selection - traps now appear in a more consistent order
 Improved UI for level selection - levels should now correctly appear in alphabetical order
 Renamed "Ghost Bridge" to "Hidden Bridge" for consistency
 Changed the name of the old "Flipper" trap to "Hidden Flipper"

Bug Fixes

 Improved trap detonation code to fix issues where permanent holes can appear in the world
 Improved grabber/puncher logic to work a lot more consistently, especially in online games
 Many other small fixes

notes.title: What’s coming next for Trapper’s Delight?
notes.content:
Work is continuing at a good pace for the next version of Trapper’s Delight and this will include a whole host of new traps to play around with. These are all still pretty early but I want to give you all a quick rundown on what is being worked on.

Puncher Trap
This trap is basically a reverse grabber trap which pushes players away. As part of this update, a lot of work has gone into improving the grabber/puncher trap logic so these traps will also be a lot more consistent in online games going forward.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/d75b854e0ff3855c8043028468d15517216b7f7c.gif

Mine
A trap intended as a hidden super trap, this explodes just like the bomb trap when stepped on after a short delay. If you are quick to react it is possible to get out of the way, but as a hidden trap which explodes nearby traps this opens up some new possibilities.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/5891951c7abdc3b255e7defd421c1653c639a5ff.gif

Slow
A hidden trap which works similarly to the freeze trap. When revealed it slows any player that steps on it for a few seconds, making any upcoming obstacles harder to get past.

Speed
A visible floor tile which is the counterpart of the slow trap. Can be placed as an incentive to be the first to reach, as only one player can activate the speed powerup contained within. The first player to step on the tile will receive a temporary speed boost, potentially allowing them to get past obstacles (or just take themselves out faster!)

Clear Floor
One of the main issues that has come up is that there aren't enough ways to make levels easier without exploding large chunks of the level with bombs. So for this next version, there will be a new trap which will remove any trap from a floor tile and replace it with a safe zone. This safe zone cannot be built on but it will gradually fade back into a normal floor tile after a few turns. This tile will only be awarded when players are failing to beat a level.

Visible Flipper
This is a minor rework with how flippers work. There is now a new variant which is a visible flipper variant which will appear alongside the hidden flipper trap. The flipper trap is renamed to “Hidden Flipper” and this new trap is just called “Flipper” trap.

Along with all of these new traps and tiles, there will be a whole host of fixes and improvements coming in the next update. So stay tuned for this!

notes.title: Minor Bugfix Patch Released
notes.content:
Fixed Trap colours not being correct when joining a game in progress
  Fixed an issue that could mean that joining a game in progress resulted in old traps that have been removed being spawned
 Fixes to trap floor colours for players joining a game in progress
 Fixed UI issues where the player count on the ready up button wasn't correct so it would fill up incorrectly
  Fixed traps being able to be placed simultaneously if two players try and place traps in the same place which could result in incorrect behaviour
 Fixed projectiles sometimes not being spawned correctly for players joining a game in progress
 Fixed players being spawned incorrectly if a player joined a game while it was transitioning between lobby and game
 Fixed late joiners not seeing correct positioning of saw blades sometimes
 Added an overlay to players when joining an online game in progress
 Revamped the Level Editor level select page interface, adding duplicate and delete level buttons

notes.title: 0.9.8 Patch Notes - Challenge Mode Out Now
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/aeef0f86b7d60eceb3da8cea244d6b94444600af.png

Hello everyone!

Today is new patch day! This new patch brings with it a brand new game mode - Challenges!

This is a brand new game mode which lets you test your trapping skills against a 40 specifically designed challenge levels. In these levels you will have to use your platforming skills and clever trap placement to get to the goal. Each level has three stars to collect, one for completing the level, another for collecting all of the coins and a final challenge for beating the target goal time. In total there are 120 challenges to complete!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/b13546e29e85c596b1e3804c0b5750125874b1c2.gif

The challenge mode also brings with it three new “Guard” enemy characters, who will be doing their best to stop you completing these new challenges! 

Each of these three guard types has their own unique behaviour, and they are all affected by traps, providing a new unique puzzle element to the game. So you will be able to put your thinking hat on to work out how to get past them using well placed traps, or use quick reactions to shift around them.

It is also now possible create your own challenge levels with the in-game level editor and share them on the Steam Workshop.

Full patch notes below:

Challenge Mode

- 40 New Challenge Levels!
- 3 enemy guard types for singleplayer challenge levels
- Level editor and Steam Workshop support for challenge mode
- Full workshop support for challenge levels
- 2 unlockable hats for completing challenge mode
- New achievements for challenge mode

Gameplay Changes

- Added a "give up" button that causes your character to fall over in shame. Defaults to "B" button on gamepads and "G" key on a keyboard.
- Added extra level information to the pause screen

Bug Fixes

- Fixed a few value syncing issues for some minor score results in online games
- Few minor UI tweaks
- Fixed a potential error caused by players leaving games which would break projectiles for that game

notes.title: Version 0.9.7 Released
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/f8f32af010b087228966d5488674539f1d25e6a2.png

0.9.7 is out now! This patch brings with it a couple of new trap types, more UI improvements, and a few new game options.
 
I would also like to remind everyone that if you want to meet fellow trappers, try our new Discord channel! If you haven’t used it, Discord is a great free app for chatting with your friends and fellow gamers. So if you want to find more people to play Trapper’s Delight with and chat about the game, then please join the community over on our Discord Channel here:
https://discord.gg/Z6TBmDS
 
Full patch notes are below:
 
Features

 Added freeze trap - a hidden floor trap which, when triggered, instantly freezes anyone stepping onto it, preventing them from moving for a few seconds
 Added grabber trap - a projectile based trap which instead of taking people out, grabs people and brings them back to the launcher
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/9514ca7c0e9c5b00a0538c25ab48b61fee07d83e.gif

 Added in-game score markers on player profiles at the bottom of the screen
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/b13834d5a7fe5b4b0ef5162252213812e5401369.png
 Added the ability to customise which traps are super traps and which are not
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/f1abdddbb7e90803835b6ad4ecdfb00fe527d359.png

 Added the option to change build time and character play time in advanced game options
 Added end of game stats screen
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/ec0000d4f9a12ae04c81f388dc589d669346e4fe.png

 
Gameplay Tweaks

 Non-hidden traps are now coloured based on who placed them, using their character colour.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/56bb47c0772b6b59ec170bd64586ef3e9d446412.png
 Hammers are now set as normal traps in the normal trap configuration
 Ghost bridges are now set as super traps in the normal trap configuration

 
Bug Fixes

 Fixed some level editor errors including stuck camera
 Fixed the server being able to briefly see hidden traps being placed 
 Few other minor fixes fixes...

notes.title: Version 0.9.6 Released
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/9310b49619cb75622c916c2d71012032a905403f.png

It's here! As mentioned last week, I have been working on a new update over the past few months. In this patch comes two major improvements! The first big new change in this patch is a completely overhauled online multiplayer including which now runs on cloud servers providing a much more consistent and stable online experience. Secondly comes a shiny new user interface, both for the main menu and the in-game interface, including adorable character portraits which appear in game!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/585ce7d74ff87e09309901dba5d9875d758bd036.gif

The full patch notes can be found below.

Networking Overhaul

Games now run on an external cloud servers which are located in several regions across the globe
Completely revamped networking platform which now means games should be much more stable and provide a more consistent experience between players


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/8788be902ac4b216c28e05342a9a17344d47599d.png

UI Overhaul

Continuing on from the previous patch, the game has received further large scale UI revamps through.
Main Menu has been reworked and is now a lot easier to use (especially with a gamepad) and is better laid out
In-game has also received a lick of polish, including new in-game character portraits, updated ready button design, better looking help panels and more!
New scene transition screen wipe
New character customisation screens
Trap selection panel improvements
And so much more!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/43c8cb70b64f5fcd0ec545d8f8af88626b660d1f.png

Gameplay Changes

Floor Traps with a cooldown timer (e.g. jump and flipper traps) now work on with a per character cooldown. This means that you are no longer able to follow another player and avoid a trap triggering on you by following them.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the camera wouldn't correctly focus on the right character at the start of a new round
Fixed end game victory particles not appearing correctly
Fixed trap spawning audio error when joining an online game in progress
Fixed controllers vibrating when other players die

notes.title: New Networking and UI Update coming this week!
notes.content:
Good day fellow Trappers! At some point in the next week or so I will be looking to release a major update to Trapper's Delight! This update includes a major revamp of the look and feel of the entire UI for the game along with a complete overhaul of the online networking backend. As part of this update, Trapper's Delight will have a shiny new logo:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/43c597b7dbb22746db0248fb6b122b66980441c7.png

Interface Updates

This UI overhaul covers pretty much all aspects of the game. Everything has been updated to have a much better style throughout, with a more consistent look. The main menu has been completely revamped with better controller support and generally is much nicer to look at and more user friendly.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/f2223733921b96c74816ec05bb2ffb1b0c050269.png

The in-game UI has received updates as well, including new animated character portraits which show off your character in all of their low-poly glory!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/7415e4ec25f59d85d4d1bdc410bac86dbcd78fc8.png

New Networking Engine

I am acutely aware that one of the game's main issues currently is the online support can often be temperamental at best. To improve this I have been spending time completely replacing the networking engine running the game.
Online games will now run on a new server-based networking engine which will result in a much more stable online connection. A lot of the game's networking logic has been improved so there should be a lot less moments where player's actions aren't quite in sync.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/fa7d206669d141b7416a2746db8fb636bd1448f9.png

Along with these major changes, this update will include a tonne of general bug fixes. I will post a more complete change list when the update goes live, hopefully near the end of this week once I have finished wrapping a few niggling bugs that still remain.

Going forward after this update I would like to look into getting more content into the game, especially more trap types. If you feel like you have a great idea for new traps in the game, I would love to hear your suggestions in the comments!

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: New UI Update is Live!
notes.content:
It's taken a bit longer than expected but the next major update for Trapper's Delight is out!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/462edf6534f81d6bc589ebaafe1b5f1cd47015e4.png

The main change in this update is a rework of the gameflow which should result in the game feeling a lot faster with a lot less time waiting inbetween rounds. The scoreboard and replay are now shown at the same time which, along with some other tweaks, means that you can now get back into the action almost instantly!

The UI has also received an overhaul, which should really help new players understand the game a lot faster.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/0c8702dc8c1d578387cba657921db318496afa13.png

The full patch notes are below:


Updated to Unity 5.5
Revamped gameflow for scoreboard and replay
Replay and Scoreboard are now one gameplay state where the scoreboard is overlayed on top of the replay. Scoreboard can be hidden to watch the replay.
Hammer traps now actually crush players when killed, squashing them into the ground
UI Updates
Complete revamp of the scoreboard interface. Should help players understand concepts such as super traps as well as working with the new replay game flow.
Greatly increased the speed of game-state transitions, which will make the game feel a lot faster to play. E.g. going from the main game to watching a replay.
Improved visuals and readability of trap selection, especially in local multiplayer
There is now a line drawn from a player's trap selection to the trap positioner to help players identify which trap is theirs, especially in local multiplayer
Added a player identification line at the beginning of the round to help players see which player they are. This is a line which goes from the player name to the actual character at the start of the round.
Added text showing you how many traps you gained per round, and warns you when you are at the maximum trap limit.
General UI improvements in local multiplayer lobby to help with profile selection
Minor main menu visual changes
Added new Trap Tutorial panel which better instructs players on how traps work. This is per player and helps with local multiplayer.
Updated the position of the countdown timer to better fit within the new UI
Bug Fixes
Fixed characters dying at the beginning on the build state sometimes
Fixed Hammer Traps hitting ghost bridges
Fixed Hammer Traps hitting walls

notes.title: Level Editor and Steam Workshop Support is Here!
notes.content:
It's been a while but that's because I have been working on a big new update for Trapper's Delight!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/cf97f0c9d683eda47fd53eab5cd251b90d164cd8.gif

This update is out now and brings it with the fully featured level editor that is used to create all of the games levels along with the ability to upload your creations to the Steam Workshop.

I hope you get chance to check it out and I look forward to seeing all of your creations on the Trapper's Delight Steam Workshop!

Here are the full patch notes for this release:

Gameplay

Level Editor is here! This is an updated level editor that is used to create all of the levels in the game. It is a powerful easy to use editor which lets you create your own environments as well as with place traps into your levels. Levels can then be uploaded to the Steam Workshop. When playing online, only the host needs to have the level. All other clients will receive any required custom levels when joining a game.
There is now a secondary Snow tileset that is used for levels. Many existing levels are now using this tileset
Levels have been updated and some now contain traps at the start.
Levels now have more descriptive names, these appear when a level is first loaded along with a level author if applicable
Traps are now less likely to be given to players when there is less space to place them. This applies to Bridge trap types and Wall trap types.
Levels can now have an empty space tile. This acts just like water and lava tiles except that bridges cannot be placed on top of them, so they will always be empty.
Added Hammer Trap kills achievement
Added achievement for uploading level to Steam Workshop


Bug Fixes

Improvements which should help fix some scene transition errors in online games
Fixed visuals on hammer trap particles not always being correct
Fixed timed pit traps being stuck open if a corpse gets stuck on them
Fixed inconsinstencies where a grass tile would be replaced with a normal tile after having multiple hidden traps placed on top of it


Interface

Added help info for Hammer Trap

notes.title: Progress Update - Level Editor is coming!
notes.content:
I just wanted to post a quick update on progress as there has been a lot of progress in the back end. The most recent major update introduced level selection as part of the on-going work to introduce more level variety and Steam Workshop support!

Work is going well in this regard with the level editor mostly done!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/e5635e1c774a5c92b4dafa146ca12502478c165f.gif

Also a fun new change is coming in the form of tilesets! Now when playing levels you will get a random tileset every level, such as the snow tileset as seen above. The details of exactly what this will change and what tilesets will be available is still to be figured out but the system is in and working.

I am hoping to push out the Steam Workshop update in the coming weeks so keep your eyes peeled for that!

notes.title: New Update - Level Playlists and more!
notes.content:
Level Select Update is Live!

I've been working on getting in more customisation and variety when it comes to levels and as part of that comes the need to select what levels people want to play.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/b9d88c9261535b3527b357ac51c6341633595034.gif

This is the first step which will eventually lead to custom levels appearing in this list along with Steam Workshop support.

As for the rest of of the patch notes:

 Features 

 When creating a game, it is now possible to select which levels you want to appear in a playlist.


 Bug Fixes 

 Fixed a bug which meant players joining a game in progress wouldn't receive the traps that were present in the level.
 Improved validation/fallbacks when trying to read in invalid data. Should fix some issues where players were getting stuck trying to load into the game.

notes.title: New Update - Hammer Trap!
notes.content:
New update has just gone live including a new trap - The Hammer Trap!

This trap will continously crush all 4 adjacent tiles while blocking off the tile it is placed on.

Features
- Added Hammer Trap
- 12 New maps - Brings the total up to 35 levels in the current rotation.

Fixes
- Removed the deselect trap button from controller support as it was only causing confusion and had seemed to have no practical use
- Fixed bombs destroying certain traps (such as projectile traps) from a greater distance than intended.

notes.title: New Update is Live including Keyboard Support for Local Multiplayer
notes.content:
New patch is now live for Trapper's Delight.

 Updates 


 Local Multiplayer now supports a single Keyboard player as well as controllers
 Added support for keyboard prompts in local multiplayer
 UI updates in local multiplayer player selection which should make it easier to select player profiles
 UI Button prompts are now supported for PlayStation controllers
 Added a ping indicator that will appear when games have notably bad connections to the server.
 Triple Ice traps toned down a bit in power



 Bug Fixes 


 Fixes which should hopefully fix the old level not being removed on level transition bug.
 Networking updates which should hopefully improve connections
 Fixed traps not being activated in the lobby sometimes

notes.title: Minor Patch Update
notes.content:
- Hopefully fixed online game issue where players would get stuck on a black screen when loading into the game from the lobby.
- Fixed UI scaling issues for some aspect ratios, should now work better with 21:9 displays


If you are having difficulty connecting to a game, try restarting Trapper's Delight. There are a few outstanding issues which seem to be fixed by this work around.

Thanks for your patience!
